CustomField.description: Red marker on an open sale: its car was sold to someone else, or the wanted model has no cars available and no car is on the sale yet.
CustomField.formula: IF(IsClosed, "", IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle__c)), IF(ISPICKVAL(Vehicle__r.Status__c, "Sold"), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "") & " This car has been sold to another customer - pick another car", IF(ISPICKVAL(Vehicle__r.Status__c, "Reserved"), IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "") & " Car reserved · Model stock: " & Vehicle__r.Model__r.Stock_Status__c, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "") & " Car available · Model stock: " & Vehicle__r.Model__r.Stock_Status__c)), IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Wanted__c)), IF(Vehicle_Model_Wanted__r.Available_Stock__c = 0, IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_red.gif", "") & " Sold out - click Request Import", IMAGE("/img/samples/flag_green.gif", "") & " In stock: " & Vehicle_Model_Wanted__r.Stock_Status__c & " - pick a car in AM Vehicle"), "")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Whether the vehicle can be sold now. Green: available or reserved. Red: sold out or sold to someone else.
CustomField.label: AM Availability
